system.description:
Beginning at 10th level, at this stage in your training, your DYNAMIC FORM! has become second nature, your tempo shifts and surges like a tide under your command.

While in your DYNAMIC FORM! state, your maximum tempo increases to 5 and you no longer need to spend all your Tempo when you cast a Taijutsu with the Finisher keyword; instead, you can choose to spend any amount of Tempo up to your current total.

Passive Tempo Benefits. While you have tempo, you gain the following benefits as well as the previous tempo benefits.

5 Tempo. You have advantage on all Dexterity Saving throws.

Finisher Tempo Benefits. When you cast a Taijutsu finisher and spend all tempo you have, gaining all previous and the following tempo benefits.

5 Tempo. At the end of the current turn, you regain Chakra points equal to the total amount of chakra you spent since the beginning of the current turn.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
